statuses.FORMULA_SPECIFIED: Mathematical definition documented; not evidence of data availability.
statuses.DATA_READY: All required inputs and provenance verified.
statuses.IMPLEMENTATION_READY: Calculation implementation tested against the frozen contract.
statuses.PRODUCTION_DISPLAY_READY: Inputs, calculation, freshness and limitations validated for display.

note: No indicator is production-display-ready. Formula existence is kept separate from data readiness and implementation readiness.

indicators.required_data: Validated option price/quote, synchronized underlying, T, rate, dividends, exercise model, solver
indicators.existing_verified_data: Bid/Ask and Last only; no IV or quote timestamp
indicators.missing_requirements: Synchronized spot, expiration time, rates/dividends, exercise style/model and quote-quality/time contract

indicators.required_data: Verified per-contract IV and declared ATM selection methodology
indicators.missing_requirements: Verified current/synchronized spot, IV values, ATM selection and coverage policy

indicators.required_data: Comparable current/historical IV series, fixed lookback/sample policy
indicators.missing_requirements: Canonical current IV, comparable time series, lookback, minimum samples, tie/flat-range policy

indicators.required_data: Comparable current/historical IV series, fixed lookback/sample policy
